GraceTechnology.Language: JavaScript ES modules, SQL, Bash and small Python delivery helpers
GraceTechnology.Runtime: Node.js 24 LTS for the product; Bun 1.3.14 only for the GRACE engineering gate
GraceTechnology.Framework: Node.js HTTP API and worker, SQLite with FTS5/WAL, systemd deployment
GraceTechnology.TestingStack: node:test, Playwright, smoke tests, backup/restore selftests, offline deployment tests, GRACE CLI 4.0.5
GraceTechnology.Observability: Structured application logs, audit trail, health endpoints, deterministic CI artifacts and GRACE verification evidence

OperationalConstraints.Constraint: Production and offline bundles must not depend on Bun or GRACE.
Use the repository Node version contract and existing project libraries instead of adding runtime dependencies for governance.
SQLite migrations are sequential, transactional and append-only after they are present in main.
API and worker share one SQLite database in WAL mode and must remain safe under restart and concurrent queue processing.
